statements.markdown: **Proposition 6.96 (Every exact sum contains exponent two).** *Let $n\ge3$ and let $D\subseteq\{2,\ldots,n\}$ satisfy $Q(D,n)=2^{n-1}-1$. Then $2\in D$. Thus the rank-two hypothesis in Theorem [6.95](#record:257bm-i7) is automatic for its exact rows. The interval restriction on $D$ is part of the assertion, not an assumption about arbitrary finite quotient sums.*
